newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set a one-week repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent on Tuesday.
The operation will run from August 6 to August 13 with bids due by 0800 GMT on August 5.
The repo rate is the bank's key tool for controlling market money liquidity. It has been unchanged since December 17 last year when it was lowered by 25 basis points.
The central bank's other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
